slides.slide_01: Budget and costs: total project budget 250000 rupees. Hardware cost 150000 rupees. Software cost 100000 rupees.
slides.slide_02: Performance target: response time below 100 milliseconds. Transcription accuracy and speaker diarization are evaluated separately.
slides.slide_03: Project schedule: prototype delivery on 15 October. User testing on 20 October. Final submission on 30 October.
slides.slide_04: Offline deployment: meeting audio stays on the local laptop. Cloud processing is optional. Internet is not required after model installation.
slides.slide_05: Risks and mitigation: overlapping speech, noisy microphones, ambiguous speaker identities. Manual review and a known speaker count reduce errors.
slides.slide_06: Meeting responsibilities: project manager coordinates work. Industrial designer selects hardware. Marketing expert studies customers. UI designer creates the interface.
